entries.value: Bruised — minor pain causes -1 on the next demanding physical action.
Fatigued — prolonged effort and travel are more difficult until resting.
Shaken — -1 against the next fear or intimidation effect.
Distracted — -1 to the next Perception-based action.
Bleeding — loses a small amount of HP after strenuous actions until treated.
Burning — takes recurring fire damage until the flames are extinguished.
Chilled — movement and Speed-based actions are reduced until warmed.
Dazed — reactions cost additional effort during the next turn.
Blinded — sight-based actions fail or suffer a major penalty.
Deafened — cannot hear speech, warnings, or sound-based effects clearly.
Poisoned — Constitution-based resistance is required as the poison progresses.
Slowed — MD is reduced until the effect ends.
Weakened — Strength-based actions suffer a penalty.
Confused — the character has difficulty distinguishing allies, enemies, or directions.
Frightened — cannot willingly approach the source of fear without succeeding on a roll.
Stunned — the character temporarily loses the ability to take normal actions.
Paralyzed — voluntary movement is impossible until the condition is broken.
Silenced — speech and voice-dependent abilities cannot be used.
Cursed — a supernatural penalty persists until its specific condition is resolved.
Petrifying — the body is slowly turning to stone and requires urgent intervention.
Possessed — an outside will occasionally contests control of the character.
Marked — a magical sign allows a hostile creature or effect to track the character.
Invisible — the character cannot be seen normally but still makes sound and leaves traces.
Regenerating — restores a small amount of HP at the end of each turn.
Inspired — may reroll one chosen die, after which this status ends.
